sections.title: The Girdles (Connectors)
points: Pectoral Girdle (Shoulder): Made of the Scapula (shoulder blade) and Clavicle (collar bone).
Pelvic Girdle (Hip): Formed by the fusion of three bones: Ilium, Ischium, and Pubis.
The Pelvis protects the Bladder and Reproductive organs (Uterus).

sections.title: Bones of the Arms vs. Legs
Digits: Hands and Feet
points: Metacarpals: 5 bones forming the palm of the hand.
Metatarsals: 5 bones forming the arch/sole of the foot.
Phalanges: 14 bones in each limb forming the fingers and toes.

sections.text: The Radius is always on the side of your Thumb! The Tibia is your Shin bone and is much larger than the Fibula.

cards.fact: The thigh bone; longest and strongest in the body.

cards.mnemonic: You drive a Car with your Carpals (wrists) and walk on Tar with your Tarsals (ankles)!
